complete_source_units.text: It will shatter the support of a lawless person, neither with tumult nor with haste.
Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the wildernesses.
As for your birth, on the day you were born they did not bind your breasts; you were not washed with water, not salted with salt, and not wrapped in swaddling cloths.
Nor did My eye spare you to do any of all these things for you, to feel anything for you. You were cast upon the face of the plain because of your life’s crookedness, on the day you were born.
I too gave them commands that were not good, and ordinances in which they would not live.
therefore behold, I am paralyzing Moab’s shoulder from its frontier cities, the choice land, the house of Asimouth above a spring of a coastal city.

They lay with the giants who fell long ago, who descended to Hades with weapons of war and put their swords beneath their heads. Their lawless deeds were upon their bones, because they terrified giants in the land of life.
Thus says the Lord: In the rejoicing of the whole earth, I will make you a wilderness.
